headline: Avient Reports Q3 Results Above Expectations and Raises Full-Year Guidance
summary: Avient announced third-quarter sales grew 10.5% to $891 million, with adjusted EPS increasing 23% to $0.86. The company also increased its full-year adjusted EPS guidance range.
why: Avient Corporation is a specialized polymer materials manufacturer. Quarterly earnings and guidance updates provide key insights into chemical sector demand and industrial manufacturing health.

impacts.name: Avient
impacts.why: Better-than-expected Q3 results and increased guidance directly drive positive equity valuation expectations.
